_dukey1215_: On Day 11, Florian Dukey arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian Dukey read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The cook borrowed Florian Dukey's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
_hitmanharry_: At the depot, Rafael Hitmanharry had practised answering to his name. At S-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael Hitmanharry let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Jakub Kal (Concord) and Rafael Hitmanharry (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Ossuary Wood on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael Hitmanharry answered to number 782. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Rafael Hitmanharry did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
New laces made Rafael Hitmanharry's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet found Wendel Red at S-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Red. Wendel Red read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F1 with the rations. Wendel Red ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Wendel Red was carried in at last.
A surgeon stopped at Wendel Red's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news.
Wendel Red came back fit for duty and discovered the section had changed the recipe for its tea. He demanded an explanation.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F1 and grazed Wendel Red's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09).

Wendel Red came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F1. Wendel Red has learned to walk bent double.

Wendel Red's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel Red is number 352. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Wendel Red watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Wendel Red traded his brother's pocket watch for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
carlosm.jr: On the way to T-F4, Leopold "Parson" Carlosm tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Leopold "Parson" Carlosm borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Parson" Carlosm watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Leopold "Parson" Carlosm heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
deltascourge1: Bastian Deltascourge came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. Bastian Deltascourge left the work of a field cook to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Bastian Deltascourge could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Florian "Bones" Peterpopping, grazed. Bastian Deltascourge cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
duncan_w_0412: Cyril Duncan found a place in T-F2 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F2. Cyril Duncan has learned to walk bent double.

Cyril Duncan wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Cyril Duncan stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Cyril Duncan ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
ethanlam724: At the depot, Gustav Ethanlam had practised answering to his name. At R-S11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Gustav Ethanlam brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Gustav Ethanlam and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Gustav Ethanlam of the Hegemony and Bram Freddie of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Asked what he will do after the war, Gustav Ethanlam said: 'Be a shepherd in Esterhaus. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

The gun at R-S11 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Nils Ewalters, grazed. Blackwater Canal has been won. Gustav Ethanlam listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Gustav Ethanlam helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other. Gustav Ethanlam got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 403. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Ethanlam folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A bullet grazed Gustav Ethanlam's ribs at R-S11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Bastian Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd).
iqsanislami: The new sniper gave his name as Felix Iqsanislami. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Felix Iqsanislami shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Felix Iqsanislami reads Ulrich Catshannon's letters from home out loud, because Ulrich never learned to read. Felix leaves out the sad parts. Ulrich knows. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Felix Iqsanislami during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Felix Iqsanislami fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick, now gravely wounded.
oaustin77: Viktor Oaustin, a lamplighter from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Viktor Oaustin lost a boot to the mud at R-S10. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog hid the far end of R-S10. Viktor Oaustin kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Viktor Oaustin discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Viktor Oaustin hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S10, Viktor Oaustin listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Viktor Oaustin took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-S10, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Viktor Oaustin fell at R-S10 and never moved again. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2).

The papers connected Florian Oaustin to Viktor Oaustin. The men took longer to learn Florian Oaustin's own habits, but they made the effort. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Oaustin is number 381 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian Oaustin read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Florian Oaustin and Nils Ewalters carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
streekluukvande: On the way to S-S17, Florian Streekluukva tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Florian Streekluukva discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S17 with the rations. Florian Streekluukva ate while listening to the revised orders.

Florian Streekluukva was hit twice at S-S17, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). Florian Streekluukva was killed at S-S17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard).

Edmund Streekluukva had heard about Florian Streekluukva's courage. At S-S17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Edmund Streekluukva got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 591. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S17. Edmund Streekluukva has learned to walk bent double.
A bullet grazed Edmund Streekluukva's ribs at S-S17. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Severin "Crow" Boy of the Hegemony (@st0nk_boy).
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Cubes at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Zeno Cubes finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The surgeon worked on Zeno Cubes until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

A letter came with Gideon "Mud" Cubes: "I am Zeno Cubes's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Gideon "Mud" Cubes wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Gideon "Mud" Cubes put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Wendel Yaboyslydude, grazed.
Gideon "Mud" Cubes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Yaboyslydude crossed it, Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired. Wendel Yaboyslydude was badly wounded.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Gideon "Mud" Cubes waited for that to change. When it did, Cyril "Brick" Jro was gravely wounded. Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Pavel Mvuisak, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was hit hard in the fight at R-F18 before anyone could fire. The raider was Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord. Raider: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord (@scottjseale). Gideon "Mud" Cubes crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Konrad Rachelejosia reached for a rifle. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@rachelejosiah) Gideon "Mud" Cubes threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was down and screaming for a medic. (@scottjseale) The Hegemony celebrated Gideon "Mud" Cubes's part in winning Blackwater Canal. He sat through the praise with a piece of ration bread still in his pocket.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped. Gideon "Mud" Cubes got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 195. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gideon "Mud" Cubes helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The medics called Gideon "Mud" Cubes 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Gideon "Mud" Cubes is back on the line.
theoneonlyfishboy: Valentin Theoneonlyfi arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Tobias Olly and Valentin Theoneonlyfi argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home reached Valentin Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Valentin Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin Theoneonlyfi looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Valentin Theoneonlyfi was carrying water up to P-F19 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Valentin Theoneonlyfi did not. Shot by Casimir Eclark of the Hegemony (@eclark43). A letter from home reached Valentin Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Valentin Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier.
tons355: The new sniper gave his name as Yann "Ash" Tons. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Yann "Ash" Tons stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Yann "Ash" Tons began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Yann "Ash" Tons wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The reply to Yann "Ash" Tons's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
victor_kabu: Clement Kabu came up on Day 9 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement Kabu helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Clement Kabu tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. Clement Kabu got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 823. The men who came later will ask about it. Orders assigned Clement Kabu to work as a stretcher bearer. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Victory at Grey Mill. Clement Kabu let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Clement Kabu and Yann Gastongimene both swear they saw a ghost at the Chalk Pits. Each says the other screamed first. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
